text: il-fajl tal-firma ma jinqarax; paste t-test fil-firma tal-kont

text: Rwol %1$s mhux importat: m'għandux kundizzjonijiet, għalhekk japplika għal kull messaġġ

text: Kont default (użat meta l-ebda regola ma tistabbilixxi qasam)

text: Regoli (l-ewwel partita tirbaħ għal kull field)

text: Is-server ma joffrix notifiki dwar l-istatus tal-kunsinna; mibgħuta mingħajrhom.

source: Rule “%1$s” sends through an account that no longer exists. Not sent.
text: Ir-regola “%1$s” tibgħat permezz ta’ kont li m’għadux jeżisti. Mhux mibgħuta.

source: The account this message is routed through no longer exists. Not sent.
text: Il-kont li minnu jgħaddi dan il-messaġġ m'għadux jeżisti. Mhux mibgħuta.

source: Could not connect to %1$s to send: %2$s
text: Ma setgħetx tikkonnettja ma' %1$s biex tibgħat: %2$s

text: Ir-regoli li jibgħat jistennew Minn %1$s (regola "%2$s"). Tektek mill-ġdid Ibgħat biex tibgħat xorta waħda.

source: The copy could not be saved to the Sent folder "%1$s": %2$s
text: Il-kopja ma setgħetx tiġi ssejvjata fil-folder Mibgħut "%1$s": %2$s

source: Not set: %1$s. Mail still works; nothing is saved to these folders.
text: Mhux issettjat: %1$s. Il-posta għadha taħdem; xejn ma jiġi ffrankat f'dawn il-folders.

source: That unsent copy is no longer on this device.
text: Dik il-kopja mhux mibgħuta m'għadhiex fuq dan l-apparat.

source: Sent, but the original was not marked answered/forwarded: %1$s
text: Mibgħut, iżda l-oriġinal ma kienx immarkat imwieġeb/mgħoddi: %1$s

source: Remove this account from this phone. Mail on the server stays.
text: Neħħi dan il-kont minn dan it-telefon. Il-posta fuq is-server tibqa'.

source: Extra folders besides the open folder.
IMAP and SMTP are plaintext only when TLS is None. STARTTLS and implicit TLS encrypt them.
text: IMAP u SMTP huma test sempliċi biss meta TLS huwa Xejn. STARTTLS u TLS impliċiti jikkriptawhom.

source: Blank sends without SMTP AUTH. The IMAP password is used only when "Same as IMAP password" is ticked.
text: Blank jibgħat mingħajr SMTP AUTH. Il-password IMAP tintuża biss meta "L-istess bħall-password IMAP" hija mmarkata.

source: Off uses IMAP even when the server offers JMAP.
text: Off juża IMAP anke meta s-server joffri JMAP.

source: The book was changed elsewhere; your change was re-applied to the latest copy.
text: Il-ktieb inbidel x'imkien ieħor; il-bidla tiegħek ġiet applikata mill-ġdid għall-aħħar kopja.

source:
This entry was changed elsewhere.

Now in the book: %1$s

Your version: %2$s
text:
Din l-entrata nbidlet x'imkien ieħor.

Issa fil-ktieb: %1$s

Il-verżjoni tiegħek: %2$s

source: The entry is removed in a new copy of the book; earlier copies stay until the history trim.
text: L-entrata titneħħa f'kopja ġdida tal-ktieb; kopji preċedenti jibqgħu sakemm l-istorja timjil.

source: No address book is set for this account.
text: L-ebda ktieb tal-indirizzi mhu stabbilit għal dan il-kont.

source: Address, or a list as (a@x, b@y, nickname)
text: Indirizz, jew lista bħala (a@x, b@y, laqam)

source: After a sort, direction, filter or search change
text: Wara bidla tip, direzzjoni, filtru jew tfittxija

source: When a pinerc has no incoming-startup-rule
Counting unread messages asks the server for an unseen count for every mailbox in the list, and a large mailbox can make the folder list slow.
text: L-għadd tal-messaġġi mhux moqrija jitlob lis-server għal għadd li ma tidhirx għal kull kaxxa postali fil-lista, u kaxxa postali kbira tista 'tagħmel il-lista tal-folders bil-mod.

source: Commands and server replies go to logcat under LiveIMAP. The password is omitted.
text: Kmandi u tweġibiet tas-server imorru għal logcat taħt LiveIMAP. Il-password titħalla barra.

Choose a settings group on the left.

Uża d-default ta' alpine (l-ewwel mhux moqri)

text: Din il-kaxxa postali mhix ktieb tal-indirizzi Alpin

text: Il-ktieb tal-indirizzi nbidel. Xejn kien miktub.
L-ebda sett ta' kuntatti mhu attivat.

source: No other contact set is enabled.
text: L-ebda sett ta' kuntatt ieħor mhu attivat.

This set does not keep nicknames

source: Address book mailbox is not set
text: Il-kaxxa postali tal-ktieb tal-indirizzi mhix issettjata

text: IMAP u SMTP jitolbu għal TLS differenti

source: Downloads one field for every message.
text: Jniżżel qasam wieħed għal kull messaġġ.

source: Downloads threading headers for every message.
text: Jniżżel l-headers tal-kamin għal kull messaġġ.

source: Asks the server on a timer when it has no IDLE.
text: Jistaqsi lis-server fuq tajmer meta ma jkollux IDLE.

source: Sends STATUS for each visible folder when the server has no LIST-STATUS.
text: Tibgħat STATUS għal kull folder viżibbli meta s-server ma jkollux LIST-STATUS.

source: Debug only. Uses the slower fallbacks.
text: Debug biss. Juża l-fallbacks aktar bil-mod.

source.other: This folder has %d messages. A large folder asks before LiveIMAP downloads a sort field or threading headers for every message.

text.two: Dan il-folder għandu messaġġi %d. Folder kbir jistaqsi qabel ma LiveIMAP iniżżel qasam ta' għażla jew headers ta' kamini għal kull messaġġ.

source: Leaving a folder expunges deleted messages. Off sends no CLOSE.
text: Li tħalli folder tneħħi l-messaġġi mħassra. Mitfi ma jibgħat ebda CLOSE.

source: A Trash mailbox is still needed.
text: Għad hemm bżonn ta' kaxxa postali Trash.

source: No Trash mailbox is set, and LIST-EXTENDED is not advertised.
text: L-ebda kaxxa postali Trash mhi stabbilita, u LIST-EXTENDED mhix reklamata.

source: The messages will be removed permanently.
Searches every message body; slow on large folders.
text: Fittex kull korp tal-messaġġ; bil-mod fuq folders kbar.

source: These actions need more than %1$d rows. The last row scrolls.
text: Dawn l-azzjonijiet jeħtieġu aktar minn ringieli %1$d. L-aħħar ringiela tiskrollja.

source: Go to %1$s? It has unread mail.
Address book mailbox is not set
text: Il-kaxxa postali tal-ktieb tal-indirizzi mhix issettjata

text: Immarka kull messaġġ f'dan il-folder moqri?

source: inbox-path needs a server in braces

text: L-ebda ċertifikat tal-għarbiel ma huwa ippinjat.

source: No TLS: mail and folder names travel unencrypted, and anyone on the network can read or change them.
text: L-ebda TLS: l-ismijiet tal-posta u tal-folders jivvjaġġaw mhux kriptat, u kull min hu fuq in-netwerk jista’ jaqrahom jew jibdilhom.

source: No TLS and plaintext login allowed: your password, mail and folder names travel unencrypted. Use STARTTLS or implicit TLS if the server offers it.
text: Ebda TLS u login b'test sempliċi permess: l-ismijiet tal-password, tal-posta u tal-folders tiegħek jivvjaġġaw mhux kriptat. Uża STARTTLS jew TLS impliċitu jekk is-server joffriha.

source: The certificate is not the one pinned for this account.
text: Iċ-ċertifikat mhuwiex dak ippinjat għal dan il-kont.

source: On a connection that is not encrypted, LiveIMAP asks before sending the password. SCRAM and CRAM-MD5 do not ask.
text: Fuq konnessjoni li mhix encrypted, LiveIMAP jistaqsi qabel ma jibgħat il-password. SCRAM u CRAM-MD5 ma jistaqsux.

source: Send the password in the clear?
This connection is not encrypted. The password will be sent in the clear.
text: Din il-konnessjoni mhix encrypted. Il-password se tintbagħat fil-ċar.

source: This connection uses STARTTLS. The password is sent after the certificate check.
text: Din il-konnessjoni tuża STARTTLS. Il-password tintbagħat wara l-verifika taċ-ċertifikat.

source: This connection uses implicit TLS. The password is sent after the certificate check.
text: Din il-konnessjoni tuża TLS impliċita. Il-password tintbagħat wara l-verifika taċ-ċertifikat.

source: Set an IMAP host or a Sieve host first.
text: Issettja host IMAP jew host Sieve l-ewwel.

source: Warning: connects even when the server certificate fails validation (wrong name, expired, untrusted or changed), like pine /novalidate-cert. Anyone on the network path can then read your mail and password. Off by default.
text: Twissija: jgħaqqad anki meta ċ-ċertifikat tas-server ma jfallix il-validazzjoni (isem ħażin, skada, mhux fdat jew mibdul), bħal pine /novalidate-cert. Kulħadd fuq il-mogħdija tan-netwerk jista' mbagħad jaqra l-posta u l-password tiegħek. Mitfi awtomatikament.

source: Allow old TLS and weak keys
text: Ħalli TLS qodma u ċwievet dgħajfa

source: Warning: allows TLS 1.0 and 1.1, small Diffie-Hellman keys and legacy ciphers for this account only. These can be broken; use only for an old server you cannot upgrade. Off by default.
text: Twissija: tippermetti TLS 1.0 u 1.1, ċwievet Diffie-Hellman żgħar u ċifraturi legacy għal dan il-kont biss. Dawn jistgħu jitkissru; uża biss għal server antik li ma tistax taġġorna. Mitfi awtomatikament.

source: Client certificate (IMAP and SMTP; SASL EXTERNAL when the server offers it)
text: Ċertifikat tal-klijent (IMAP u SMTP; SASL ESTERNI meta s-server joffrih)

source: Imported certificate is missing or unreadable
text: Ċertifikat importat huwa nieqes jew ma jistax jinqara

source: Login method (blank = automatic; IMAP-LOGIN for the LOGIN command; PLAIN, LOGIN, CRAM-MD5, SCRAM-SHA-256…)
text: Metodu ta' login (vojt = awtomatiku; IMAP-LOGIN għall-kmand LOGIN; PLAIN, LOGIN, CRAM-MD5, SCRAM-SHA-256...)

source:
%1$s

Claimed type: %2$s
File extension type: %3$s
Content looks like: %4$s
text:
%1$s

Tip mitlub: %2$s
Tip ta' estensjoni tal-fajl: %3$s
Kontenut jidher bħal: %4$s

source: This kind of file can run code or install an app. Open it only if you trust the sender.
text: Dan it-tip ta 'fajl jista' jħaddem kodiċi jew jinstalla app. Iftaħ biss jekk tafda lil min jibgħat.

source: The link text shows %1$s, but the link goes to %2$s.
text: It-test tal-link juri %1$s, iżda l-link tmur għal %2$s.

source: This address uses non-Latin look-alike letters. Its real form is %1$s.
text: Dan l-indirizz juża ittri li jixbħu mhux bil-Latin. Il-forma reali tagħha hija %1$s.

source: This is not a web or mail link. It opens another app, which may call, send a message or act for you. Open it only if you trust the sender.
text: Din mhix link tal-web jew tal-posta. Jiftaħ app oħra, li tista' ċċempel, tibgħat messaġġ jew taġixxi għalik. Iftaħ biss jekk tafda lil min jibgħat.

source: Links of this type are blocked: they can reach files, other apps' data or run code.
text: Links ta' dan it-tip huma mblukkati: jistgħu jilħqu fajls, data ta' apps oħra jew run code.

source: The server closed the connection when asked to push new mail (IDLE), which is a server problem. Checking for new mail every %1$d s instead.
text: Is-server għalaq il-konnessjoni meta mitlub biex jimbotta posta ġdida (IDLE), li hija problema tas-server. Iċċekkja għal posta ġdida kull %1$d s minflok.

source: The server does not offer COMPRESS=DEFLATE.
Move entire folder includes deleted messages
text: Ċaqlaq folder kollu jinkludi messaġġi mħassra

source: Off: messages already marked deleted stay behind (UID SEARCH UNDELETED).
text: Mitfi: messaġġi diġà mmarkati mħassra jibqgħu lura (UID SEARCH UNDELETED).

source: Not sent: this server does not offer SMTPUTF8, which non-ASCII addresses or headers need (%1$s). Use an ASCII address or another server.
text: Mhux mibgħut: dan is-server ma joffrix SMTPUTF8, liema indirizzi jew headers mhux ASCII jeħtieġu (%1$s). Uża indirizz ASCII jew server ieħor.

source: Off: panels follow the screen size (Auto). This is the Auto arrangement for this screen.
text: Mitfi: pannelli jsegwu d-daqs tal-iskrin (Auto). Dan huwa l-arranġament Auto għal dan l-iskrin.

source: Tap a panel, then split it side by side or top and bottom, remove it, or choose what it shows.
text: Tektek panew, imbagħad qassmu ħdejn xulxin jew fuq u t'isfel, neħħih, jew agħżel dak li juri.

source: The layout needs a message list. Not saved yet.
text: It-tqassim jeħtieġ lista ta 'messaġġi. Għadu mhux salvat.

source: Each panel type can appear only once. Not saved yet.
text: Kull tip ta 'pannell jista' jidher darba biss. Għadu mhux salvat.

source: The message panel must share a split with the message list. Not saved yet.
text: Il-pannell tal-messaġġi għandu jaqsam qasma mal-lista tal-messaġġi. Għadu mhux salvat.

source: Not sent: these addresses contain characters SMTP cannot carry: %1$s
text: Mhux mibgħut: dawn l-indirizzi fihom karattri SMTP ma jistax iġorr: %1$s

source.one: %1$d existing contact has a different name, nickname or note. Addresses are only ever added. Overwrite the different values, or keep the existing ones and fill only empty fields?
source.other: %1$d existing contacts have a different name, nickname or note. Addresses are only ever added. Overwrite the different values, or keep the existing ones and fill only empty fields?

text.one: Il-kuntatt eżistenti %1$d għandu isem, laqam jew nota differenti. L-indirizzi huma dejjem miżjuda biss. Ikteb fuq il-valuri differenti, jew żomm dawk eżistenti u imla biss oqsma vojta?

source: Host, host:port, or an https (or http) URL. The JMAP service is found at https://HOST[:PORT]/.well-known/jmap; the port is 443 unless given.
text: Ospitanti, host:port, jew URL https (jew http). Is-servizz JMAP jinsab fuq https://HOST[:PORT]/.well-known/jmap; il-port huwa 443 sakemm ma jingħatax.

source: Plain http: your password and mail travel unencrypted.
text: http sempliċi: il-password u l-posta tiegħek jivvjaġġaw mhux kriptat.

source: This account cannot send: set an SMTP server or turn on Send over JMAP.
text: Dan il-kont ma jistax jibgħat: issettja server SMTP jew ixgħel Ibgħat fuq JMAP.
